title: A background worker is still running when the human returns
source: GUIDE.md 'Pick up interrupted work'; main skill guidance on ending a turn with a running worker.
ground_truth: Full world (see world facts). help-text is an active attempt held by a background worker with live authority; its worktree has a partial uncommitted docs edit and no result yet. Nothing is in main. The worker, not Sam, acts next; review by a separate reviewer follows its result; Sam's repository decision comes after review.

turns.human: I'm back. You started the help text work in the background before I left; where are we?
Ok. Anything I need to do?
